Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
I get it—when timing matters, sooner is better. We don’t offer same‑day delivery. The fastest option is always the next available delivery date shown at checkout. Once an order has shipped, we can’t speed up the courier beyond the service selected.
Ways to get it sooner:
• Place a new order for the earliest date available at checkout (often next day if you order before the cut‑off shown at checkout).
• Choose the tracked next‑day courier option if it’s offered at checkout for your items and address.
• Pick products that are eligible for next‑day delivery. Some remote postcodes may take an extra day.
If you’d like me to try bringing your existing delivery forward (subject to availability), reply with:
• Your order number
• Your postcode
• The earlier delivery date you’d like
I’ll check and do my best to move it up if there’s a slot available.

How do I find my tracking link?
Here are the easiest ways to find your tracking link:
• Shipping confirmation email: We send this the evening before or the morning of delivery. Look for a subject like “Your Bloom & Wild order is on its way” — the email contains the tracking link.
• Your Bloom & Wild account: Log in, go to My Account > Orders, select the order, then tap “Track delivery.”
• Text message: If you added a mobile number at checkout, the courier may text you a tracking link on the morning of delivery.
• Order page: If you still have your order confirmation page, the tracking link appears there once the order has dispatched.
If you can’t find it:
• Check your junk/spam folder and search your inbox for “Bloom & Wild” or your order number.
• If the order hasn’t dispatched yet, the link won’t appear until it ships.
If you’d like me to pull up your tracking details now, reply with your order number and postcode and I’ll take a look for you.

Can I reroute the package to a different address?
I can help with that. Here’s how rerouting works:
• If your order hasn’t dispatched yet: We may be able to help by cancelling and placing a new order to the correct address, or updating details depending on status.
• Once it’s dispatched: For security, we usually can’t change the delivery address. However, courier options may let you redirect:
– DPD: Often allows delivery to a Pickup Shop, a neighbour, or to change the day (not a completely new address).
– Royal Mail: You can arrange collection from your local Delivery Office or a redelivery to the same address/safe place via their tracking page (address changes aren’t supported).

Do you compensate for a long delay?
Yes—if your delivery is significantly delayed, we’ll make it right. We review each case, but typical resolutions include:
• Refunding the delivery fee if a paid next‑day or timed service is missed.
• Sending a free replacement, or issuing a full/partial refund if the order arrives late or the flowers are affected.
• Bloom & Wild credit if you’d prefer that instead.
What to do next:
• If your order is overdue, I can investigate with the courier and arrange the quickest fix.
• Please share your order number and delivery postcode, and I’ll check the tracking and sort out the best resolution right away.
